Name: Genrebear's Nicer Shed
Author: genrebear
Description:
A shed with a different shape and layout to change some things up. They're slightly bigger than the vanilla version, but without being overwhelmingly big or unbalanced. 


★ Compatibility ★
    1.6+ compatible
    It may or may not be compatible with recolors, I haven't tested to check
    Not compatible with other mods which change the shed layout

★ Installation ★
    Download and install the requirements
    Extract "[CP] Genrebear's Nicer Shed" folder to Stardew Valley/Mods
    Run the game with SMAPI

Manifest.Name: Genrebear's Nicer Shed
Manifest.Description: Replaces the vanilla shed interior with a nicer and slightly bigger version.
